Can quantum error correction make quantum computers reliable?

Yes, in principle -- the threshold theorem is proven math. Caveat: fault tolerance still needs many physical qubits per logical qubit today.

#QuantumComputing
Well actually, quantum error correction needs many physical qubits to make one logical qubit, that's why scaling is so hard.
